name: Sword of the Orc King
author: Foppygames
description: A turn-based roguelike in progress: explore the dungeon, fight orcs and bats, pick up what you find. On-screen d-pad and buttons, or a keyboard. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: A turn-based roguelike in progress: explore the dungeon, fight orcs and bats, pick up what you find. On-screen d-pad and buttons, or a keyboard. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Un roguelike a turni (ancora in sviluppo): esplora il sotterraneo, combatti orchi e pipistrelli, raccogli quello che trovi. Croce direzionale e tasti sullo schermo, o tastiera. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
